name: Legal and data rights
crit: Written confirmation of the licence (NL) and data rights (NBA §9) for every input and output.

name: Data provenance and completeness
crit: Each input has a URL, retrieval time (UTC), hash, and missingness report.
status: Partly met for official schedule/injury files; no provenance pipeline yet

name: Leakage-free walk-forward backtest
crit: Features use only information available at each prediction time.

name: Calibration against a baseline
crit: Proper scoring rule (Brier or log loss) with interval, versus a no-vig market baseline.

name: Closing-line value against timestamped market
crit: Price taken vs. closing price, if lawfully available.

name: Net return after costs with bootstrap interval
crit: ROI after vig, fees and limits, with an interval.

name: Prospective paper trial
crit: Frozen model, pre-registered sample size, logged before games.

name: Correlation and parlay joint calibration
crit: Measured joint probabilities versus the product of legs, with interval and sample count. Values blank until measured.

name: Luck control across strategies
crit: Multiple-testing correction across all strategies tested (threshold set by owner, SG-04).

name: Stability by season and segment
crit: Results hold across seasons and segments (prop family, team, horizon).
